projects.name: Agentic OS
projects.description: Local-first mission control / lane board over the CCv3 coordination plane. Reads the agentic_os schema plus read-only views of public.sessions, file_claims, archival_memory.
projects.notes: Shares the continuous_claude database with 3 other apps. NEVER run drizzle-kit push - it diffs live and would drop the other apps 40 public tables. Migrations only: db:generate -> db:check -> db:migrate, schemaFilter [agentic_os]. e2e: runs its own dev server on 3011 (dashboard stays on 3010); needs npm ci at the repo root (Playwright lives there) and AGENTIC_OS_DATABASE_URL or apps/agentic-os/.env.local.

e2e.command: npm run typecheck && npm run db:check && npm run e2e
